label: Engines as the reward function
subgoals: Define the action as a model output
Compute the reward by running engines on it
Raise the probability of above-average actions

label: What can be rewarded
subgoals: Distinguish binary verdicts from continuous metrics
Gate on verdicts before scoring metrics
Prefer rewards a checker can establish exactly

label: Where the reward is computed
subgoals: Use fast engines for most rewards
Compute customer-data rewards on-site in the sandbox
Version reward engines and keep them deterministic
